title: Access the Strava API
text: functions require Strava account personal API, can obtained Strava website. user account can created following instructions Strava homepage. account created, personal API can created API tab profile settings. user must application name (chosen user), client id (different athlete id), application secret create authentication token. Additional information personal API can found . Every API retrieval function rStrava package requires authentication token (called stoken help documents). following suggested workflow using API functions rStrava. First, create authentication token using personal information API. Replace app_name, app_client_id, app_secret objects relevant info account. Setting cache = TRUE strava_oauth create authentication file working directory. can used later sessions follows: Finally, get_heat_map get_elev_prof functions require key Google API. Follow instructions . key can added R environment file later use:
code: app_name <- 'myappname' # chosen by user app_client_id  <- 'myid' # an integer, assigned by Strava app_secret <- 'xxxxxxxx' # an alphanumeric secret, assigned by Strava  # create the authentication token stoken <- httr::config(token = strava_oauth(app_name, app_client_id, app_secret, app_scope="activity:read_all")) stoken <- httr::config(token = readRDS('.httr-oauth')[[1]]) # save the key, do only once cat("google_key=XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX\n",     file = file.path(normalizePath("~/"), ".Renviron"),     append = TRUE)  # retrieve the key, restart R if not found google_key <- Sys.getenv("google_key")

title: Access the Strava API
text: API retrieval functions used token. example creating heat map activities:  Plotting elevation grade single ride:   Get elevation profiles activities:   Plot average speed per split (km mile) activity:  Additional functions provided get “stream” information individual activities. Streams provide detailed information location, time, speed, elevation, gradient, cadence, watts, temperature, moving status (yes/) individual activity. Use get_activity_streams detailed info activities: Stream data can plotted using plotting functions.
code: myinfo <- get_athlete(stoken, id = '2837007') head(myinfo) ## $id ## [1] 2837007 ##  ## $username ## [1] "beck_marcus" ##  ## $resource_state ## [1] 2 ##  ## $firstname ## [1] "Marcus" ##  ## $lastname ## [1] "Beck" ##  ## $bio ## [1] "" library(dplyr)  # get activities by date range my_acts <- get_activity_list(stoken, after = as.Date('2020-12-31')) act_data <- compile_activities(my_acts)   # subset by location toplo <- act_data %>%      filter(grepl('Run$', name)) %>%      filter(start_latlng2 < -82.63 & start_latlng2 > -82.65) %>%      filter(start_latlng1 < 27.81 & start_latlng1 > 27.78)   get_heat_map(toplo, key = google_key, col = 'darkred', size = 1.5, distlab = F, alpha = 0.6, zoom = 13) # get data for a single activity my_acts <- get_activity_list(stoken, id = '1784292574') act_data <- compile_activities(my_acts)   # plot elevation along a single ride get_heat_map(my_acts, alpha = 1, add_elev = T, distlab = F, key = google_key, size = 2, col = 'Spectral', units = 'imperial') ## |---------|---------|---------|---------|========================================= # plot % gradient along a single ride get_heat_map(my_acts, alpha = 1, add_elev = T, distlab = F, as_grad = T, key = google_key, size = 2, col = 'Spectral', units = 'imperial') get_elev_prof(my_acts, key = google_key, units = 'imperial') get_elev_prof(my_acts, key = google_key, units = 'imperial', total = T) # plots for most recent activity plot_spdsplits(my_acts, stoken, units = 'imperial') # get streams for the first activity in my_acts strms_data <- get_activity_streams(my_acts, stoken) head(strms_data) ## 3    309.9   0.0082         -2.2 33.60581 -117.8020   TRUE   11            2.52 ## 4    309.7   0.0141         -3.2 33.60580 -117.8020   TRUE   13            3.96 ## 5    309.6   0.0180         -1.6 33.60580 -117.8019   TRUE   14           10.44 ## 6    309.5   0.0223          0.0 33.60580 -117.8019   TRUE   15           11.52 ##           id ## 1 1784292574 ## 2 1784292574 ## 3 1784292574 ## 4 1784292574 ## 5 1784292574 ## 6 1784292574 # heat map get_heat_map(strms_data, alpha = 1, filltype = 'speed', size = 2, col = 'Spectral', distlab = F) ##
